card.name: Digits inside scholarly citation page numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits within page or verse numbers in old-style scholarly citations, often in the middle of a number or page range, in classical, biblical or historical footnotes.

modes.label: Page ranges
modes.description: A digit inside a page number or range in a bibliographic reference.

modes.label: Classical and biblical verse numbers
modes.description: A digit in a section or verse number after an ancient author or Bible book.

card.plain: It fires on the digits inside page and verse numbers in old scholarly footnotes.
